authority: Web/backend database RPC; clients display results and never infer requirements
rules: A certificate never activates actual special work.
Actual blasting/electrical/welding is selected for one active project membership by an authorized project manager or safety officer.
site_projects.includes_drilling=true requires drilling training for every active project member; EXAM-DRILL-001 decides whether an exam is additionally required.
Drilling never requires a personal drilling certificate.
Internal employees, contractors and temporary individuals use the same special-work gate; employee three-level education remains independent.

rpcs.name: training_set_member_special_work_types
rpcs.idempotency: same normalized set returns changed=false; the member row lock serializes concurrent updates

rpcs.name: training_current_special_requirements
rpcs.freshness: calculated at query time from current membership, project drilling flag, exact certificate state, published plans, assignments and published exam configuration

response.items: training_current_special_requirements response for every active member

rpcs.name: training_set_package_special_requirements
rpcs.authorization: company admin for a global draft package, or site_project_can_manage for its project draft package
rpcs.mapping_guard: training plan level must be special and plan.special_type must exactly equal rule.special_type; null or mismatched legacy mappings fail closed
rpcs.idempotency: atomic replace while the package row is locked; published packages are immutable

audit.operator_identity: operator_id is a nullable live auth reference; operator_subject_id is the immutable stable UUID snapshot retained after account deletion
audit.immutability: business UPDATE and all DELETE operations are rejected; only the auth foreign key may clear operator_id while the snapshot and every other audit field remain unchanged

security.client_truncate: anon and authenticated have no TRUNCATE privilege on D12 authoritative core tables

boundaries.D13: owns question selection, attempts, scoring and retries; D12 only publishes the required special exam plan and current requirement state
boundaries.D17: owns configurable retraining caused by major content or regulation changes
boundaries.D18: combines this current special status with all other qualification facts
boundaries.D11: one-time employee three-level education is not changed by D12
